description: This file defines constants, macros, enums, and function prototypes related to color handling in a terminal, including ANSI escape sequences, color configuration, and output functions.

methods.name: git_config_colorbool
methods.description: Parses a color boolean configuration value.

methods.name: want_color_fd
methods.description: Determines whether to use color output for a given file descriptor and color setting.

methods.name: color_parse
methods.description: Parses a color value string into terminal-compatible format.

methods.name: color_parse_mem
methods.description: Parses a color value string with specified length into terminal-compatible format.

methods.name: color_fprintf
methods.description: Prints formatted colored output to a file stream.

methods.name: color_fprintf_ln
methods.description: Prints formatted colored output with newline to a file stream.

methods.name: color_print_strbuf
methods.description: Prints the contents of a strbuf with color formatting.

methods.name: color_is_nil
methods.description: Checks if a color value indicates 'no color'.
